name: Cylindropuntia fosbergii
desc: Cylindropuntia fosbergii (Cylindropuntia fosbergii): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 19 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Cylindropuntia fosbergii is a species of cactus known by the common names Hoffmann's teddybear cholla, pink teddy-bear cholla, and Mason Valley cholla.
